name: Pikol
title: The Commander of Abimelech's Army
summary: Pikol was the commander (chief officer) of Philistine king Abimelech in Gerar. He was present at the covenants between Abimelech and Abraham, and later between Abimelech and Isaac. His presence underscored the military and political significance of these agreements.

keyEvents.title: The Covenant Between Abraham and Abimelech at Beersheba
keyEvents.description: Pikol was present as Abimelech's commander when Abimelech sought a covenant with Abraham. They made an agreement at Beersheba for peaceful coexistence.

keyEvents.title: Abimelech and Pikol Return to the Land of the Philistines
keyEvents.description: After the covenant was made, Abimelech and Pikol returned to the land of the Philistines, confirming the diplomatic nature of the visit.

keyEvents.title: Abimelech and Pikol Visit Isaac
keyEvents.description: Pikol again accompanied Abimelech when they visited Isaac in Beersheba to make a covenant, because they saw that God was with Isaac.

keyEvents.title: Isaac's Covenant with Abimelech in the Presence of Phicol
keyEvents.description: Isaac asked why they had come to him after sending him away, but Abimelech and Phicol sought peace. They made a covenant and celebrated with a meal.

keyEvents.title: Departure After Making the Covenant with Isaac
keyEvents.description: After making the covenant, Isaac bid farewell to Abimelech and Phicol, and they left him in peace, securing peaceful relations between the groups.
